## Constraints

### Must

- Use the shadcn-named tokens from bridge.css (bg-card, text-muted-foreground, border-border, primary) so 21st components inherit the Masayume look
- Numbers in JetBrains Mono; money always with its unit
- Token logos from public/tokens via TokenLogo
- Work at 390px with no horizontal scroll
- Plain words: no finance jargon in labels

### Avoid

- glass or blur panels
- decorative gradients and glows
- new fonts or a second accent colour
- framer-motion imports (use motion/react)
- sonner (use components/ui/toast)
- lightweight-charts for new desk charts (TradingView logo)
